subject.title: Feature: Message continuation marker for batched input (cost savings)

question: Should OpenClaw support user-declared continuation across pauses in addition to the existing timer-based inbound debounce?
rationale: Current main solves rapid split-send batching but not explicit hold-until-final behavior; accepting the remainder creates a public message syntax, configuration surface, and session-state lifecycle that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep debounce only
options.body: Treat `messages.inbound` as the canonical cost-saving batching path and decline a second marker protocol.

options.title: Design explicit continuation
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical marker design item and specify unified timeout, restart, media, command, typing, and transcript behavior before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep debounce only
recommendation.body: Treat `messages.inbound` as the canonical cost-saving batching path and decline a second marker protocol.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest combined implementation history and repeated product-review context for shared inbound debounce point to steipete.
